title: Three Winters and One Short Rope
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：sheep　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 sheep 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the herder ① kept the sheep that no neighbour in the pasture would have counted, and he said the keeping was the whole of the winter. The ② sheep, meaning the animal itself and not the rope, ran three winters and stayed uncounted in the book; a sheep, he said, is the only thing in a pasture that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ sheep in that pasture had the same short rope beside it, and the ④ sheep at the far pen, meaning the lamb they kept for the children to raise and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A sheep, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the herder said the counting is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the sheep was the whole of the matter, meaning the gentleness and not the animal. The ⑥ sheep, meaning the gentleness and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; sheep, he said, is either something you keep or the only word that means both an animal and a gentleness. He said the gentleness is the part they remember.

By 1992 the ⑦ sheep had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short rope. The ⑧ sheep of the whole thing, the herder wrote in December, was one pasture and three winters of counting; sheep, he said, is either the lamb at the far pen or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ sheep I remember is the animal counted in the ledger, which closed in 1994 and is still counted as the quietest in the pasture. A ⑩ sheep, my mother said in 1996, is the only animal that improves by being counted; every sheep, she said, is a gentleness that has agreed to look like an animal. She said the gentleness was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 羊；绵羊（指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 羊；绵羊（指那只羊本身，与短短的缰绳相对）
C. 固定搭配：keep the sheep 放这一只羊
D. n. 羊；绵羊（指留给孩子们养的那一只）
E. n. 羊之事（抽象总称，指一处牧场的羊之事）
F. n. 羊；绵羊（指牧群台账里写到、被清点的那一只）
G. n. 羊、温顺（指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 温顺（抽象总称，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: kept the sheep that no neighbour in the pasture would have counted
The sheep, meaning the animal itself and not the rope
the sheep at the far pen
the sheep was the whole of the matter

The sheep of the whole thing

answers.why: keep the sheep 意为“放这一只羊”，1987 年那位牧人把牧场里没有一位邻人肯清点的一只羊做了一遍。
sheep 意为“羊；绵羊”，指那只羊本身而不是短短的缰绳，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被清点。
sheep 意为“羊；绵羊”，指牧场里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一根短短的缰绳。
sheep 意为“羊；绵羊”，指最远那处圈栏的留给孩子们养的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
sheep 意为“羊、温顺”，指一件事里人人都养却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只温顺就是那件事的全部。
sheep 意为“温顺”，指人人都养却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只羊，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
sheep 意为“羊；绵羊”，指牧群台账里写到、被清点的那一只，到 1992 年这一只成了牧群台账里的一行。
sheep 意为“羊之事”，牧人十二月写道，整件事的羊之事是一处牧场和三个冬天的清点。
sheep 意为“羊；绵羊”，我记得的是牧群台账里清点过的那一只，1994 年清点了，至今仍被说成牧场里最安静的一只。
sheep 为抽象总称，母亲 1996 年说，羊是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的羊。
